warhead.provenance: 3 kg HE-frag proximity-fuzed warhead per OOB (csg-cn-hhq10-wsn, C-only). Explosive/case split, damage are engineering-estimate surrogates for a short-range point-defence missile warhead.

fuze.provenance: Proximity fuze per OOB (csg-cn-hhq10-wsn, C-only); exact timing data not public, engineering-estimate scaffold values used.

_real_world.designation: HHQ-10 (FL-3000N export lineage); newer HQ-10A revealed Sep 2025
_real_world.role: Point-defence missile vs anti-ship cruise missiles and aircraft (RAM-analogue, not a rolling airframe design)
_real_world.range_nmi: 9 km vs subsonic / 6 km vs supersonic (AFCEA citing FL-3000N Zhuhai 2008 advertised stats, export-derived, B) / ~5 km practical vs ASCM (C-only) / 0.5 km minimum range (C-only)
_real_world.guidance_real: RF (passive radar) midcourse via two RF horns in nose + passive IR/imaging IR terminal homing
_real_world.launcher_note: 24-cell (trial ship 892, Type 055), 18-cell (Liaoning), 8-cell (Type 056); Type 052D stern 24-cell reported (C); Fujian carries 'multiple HHQ-10 short-range missile launchers' (USNI Pro 2026, B), exact count not public (4x18-cell commonly claimed, C-only)

warhead.type.note: blast_fragmentation matches the sourced HE-frag/proximity-fuze description

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

mass_kg.note: missile dimensions ~2.0 m x 0.12-0.127 m, ~20 kg mass

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the 9 km max range (subsonic-target case, B, export-derived) at the >Mach 2 sourced speed

flight_model.max_speed.note: >Mach 2 (C-only); Mach 2 sea-level ~680 m/s used as a conservative lower-bound proxy

flight_model.max_g.note: maneuver limit up to 20 g per OOB (C-only)

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with the sourced 20g maneuver limit for a short-range point-defence missile

guidance.type.note: passive IR/imaging IR terminal homing per OOB; Infrared is the matching engine seeker_type. RF midcourse (via two RF horns) is not separately modeled since the engine's guidance.type field takes one seeker_type value

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public IR seeker acquisition range; engineering estimate typical of a short-range point-defence missile's imaging-IR seeker, consistent with the sourced ~5-9 km engagement envelope

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode modeled beyond the described IR terminal homing

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, tuned slightly faster than the packet's longer-range SAMs consistent with HHQ-10's short-range, high-agility point-defence role

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; no public guidance-law constant, set high consistent with a point-defence missile's terminal intercept of a maneuvering high-speed ASCM

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, consistent with engaging a sea-skimming/maneuvering ASCM; not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; very fast, consistent with a short-range, high-agility point-defence missile

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold consistent with flight_model.max_g

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate for a small point-defence missile warhead, no public lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure; set low consistent with the small 3 kg warhead mass, sufficient to disable/deflect an incoming ASCM

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 3 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: engineering-estimate scaled from the packet's larger-warhead projection-geometry template, slightly higher fraction reflecting a proximity-fuzed fragmentation pattern's relatively larger lethal-fraction radius for its small size

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: engineering-estimate scaled from the template pattern for this warhead's small lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: engineering-estimate, low given the small warhead size

fuze.type.note: proximity fuze per OOB; radar_proximity is the matching real engine-recognized fuze type

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: no public standoff distance; engineering-estimate scaffold value matching warhead.lethal_radius

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold value, fast consistent with a small proximity-fuzed intercept warhead

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: ciws mount type per task's mount rules, with can_intercept_missiles: true set on the ship record's naval_weapon_system.mounts[] entry (this Missile record documents the round; the mount-level flag is what enables engine anti-missile intercept behavior).

Range figures are export-brochure-derived (FL-3000N, Zhuhai 2008) for the AFCEA 9 km/6 km figures; PLAN in-service HHQ-10 performance is not independently confirmed to match. HQ-10A (revealed Sep 2025) performance is entirely non-public and not separately modeled; this record represents the baseline/most-documented HHQ-10 round used across the fleet as of 2026.
